author_turn1.scope: Differential jet coordinates, local spanning example, spectral weights; no statistical or global elliptic theorem inferred from finite checks

author_turn2.scope: Extension matching, finite-rank symmetrized kernel and spectral-continuity controls; stochastic consistency is proved analytically in TURN_2.md

historical_independent.scope: Jet spanning in dimensions2–6, degenerate-eigenspace basis invariance, finite-order extension weights and stationary pair-covariance identity; no analytic or empirical consistency inferred from these finite controls.

empirical.scope: Exact finite Markov and reflection controls, analytic exponent/positivity checks. Universal convergence is audited in REPORT.md; no finite test proves it.
